translations.EN: That is kind of you to say.
Thank you. That is very nice of you.
I appreciate the kind words.
That is generous of you. Thanks.
Thanks. It is rare to get compliments out here.
translations.TL: Salamat. Bihira ang papuri sa panahong ito.

translations.EN: That puts a smile on my face. Thank you.
You are too kind.
I appreciate that. Truly.
Thanks. I will take all the good words I can get.
translations.TL: Salamat. Tatanggapin ko ang anumang magandang salita ngayon.

translations.EN: Thank you. That brightens things up a bit.
translations.TL: Salamat. Nabigyan mo ng kaunting liwanag ang araw ko.

translations.EN: I appreciate the compliment.
Thanks for the compliment.
I will take the compliment. Thank you.
translations.TL: Tatanggapin ko ang papuri. Maraming salamat.

translations.EN: Much obliged for the kind thought.
Thanks. I work hard at what I do.
translations.TL: Salamat. Pinagsisikapan ko talaga ang ginagawa ko.

translations.EN: That is good feedback to hear.
Appreciated. I try to stay sharp.
Thank you. It means something coming from you.
I am flattered. Thank you.
translations.TL: Natutuwa ako sa sinabi mo. Salamat.

translations.EN: Thanks. That boost is welcome.
You noticed. Thank you.
Glad somebody noticed.
I was wondering if anyone would catch that. Thanks.
translations.TL: Iniisip ko nga kung may makakapansin niyan. Salamat.

translations.EN: Good eye. Thanks for noticing.
translations.TL: Matalas ang paningin mo. Salamat sa pagpansin.

translations.EN: I put some effort into that. Good to see it showed.
Thanks. Nice to know it did not go unseen.
translations.TL: Salamat. Masarap malaman na hindi 'yon nabalewala.

translations.EN: You have sharp observation skills. Thank you.
Appreciate you noticing that detail.
translations.TL: Salamat at napansin mo ang detalyeng 'yon.

translations.EN: I try my best. Thank you for noticing.
translations.TL: Ginagawa ko ang buong makakaya ko. Salamat sa pagpansin.

translations.EN: Thanks. That was worth the effort then.
translations.TL: Salamat. Naging sulit ang pagod ko dahil diyan.
